fields.name: density
fields.rationale: Density is a key material property that affects the structural and thermal performance of precast concrete products.

fields.name: layer_thickness
fields.rationale: Layer thickness is important for understanding the insulation and structural capabilities of the concrete product.

fields.name: insulation_type
fields.rationale: The type of insulation integrated into the concrete affects its thermal performance and application suitability.
inference_basis: Wood fibre insulation is mentioned, suggesting it is a key feature.

fields.name: load_bearing_capability
fields.rationale: Knowing whether the product is load-bearing or non-load-bearing is crucial for its application in construction.
evidence: "suitable for the construction of above-ground and below-ground load-bearing or non-load-bearing interior and exterior walls"
inference_basis: The product is described as suitable for both load-bearing and non-load-bearing applications.

fields.name: application_area
fields.rationale: The application area (interior, exterior, both) is important for determining the suitability of the product for specific construction needs.
evidence: "suitable for the construction of above-ground and below-ground load-bearing or non-load-bearing interior and exterior walls"
inference_basis: The product is described as suitable for both interior and exterior walls.
